messages.text:
Hashrate: 30 TH/s Turbo · 24 TH/s Balanced · 18 TH/s ECO
Power at the wall: 485 W Turbo · 350 W Balanced · 230 W ECO
Efficiency: 16.2 J/TH Turbo · 14.6 J/TH Balanced · 12.8 J/TH ECO

These contradict Helium Deploy’s own earlier figures — their X post said “30 TH/s, 405 watts, 13.5 J/TH,” and the product page quoted a 360–450 W band. This puts Turbo at 485 W, outside that band entirely.
Handed to the team · cannot confirm per-mode hashrate, wall power or J/TH figures from product data

You're right that those don't line up, and I'm not going to guess which set is correct. I've put it in front of JD, who does the hardware here, so you get the real per-mode numbers rather than a reconciliation I invented. Stay in the chat and he'll jump in; if you step away it comes to your email.
